name: SIT9367AI-2B1-25E322.265625
title: SiT9367: 220 MHz to 725 MHz low-jitter differential MEMS oscillator, LVPECL, low-swing LVPECL, LVDS or HCSL
summary: A factory-programmed MEMS clock oscillator with a differential output, any frequency from 220.000001 MHz to 725 MHz, and phase jitter near 0.2 ps RMS over 12 kHz to 20 MHz. Output type, supply (2.5, 2.8, 3.0 or 3.3 V), stability (±10 to ±50 ppm), temperature grade and pin 1 function are chosen by the ordering code, in 3.2 x 2.5, 5.0 x 3.2 or 7.0 x 5.0 mm six-pad packages. SIT9367AI-2B1-25E322.265625 is the 322.265625 MHz LVDS part, ±20 ppm, 2.5 V, -40 to 85 °C, with output enable on pin 1, in the 3.2 x 2.5 mm package, supplied in bulk.

operation.text: Frequency, stability, supply voltage, output type and the function of pin 1 are all set at the factory and named by the ordering code. Any frequency from 220.000001 MHz to 725 MHz can be ordered to six decimal places; with HCSL output the top frequency is 500 MHz. The SiT9366 and SiT9365 cover other frequencies.

A MEMS resonator with a second MEMS temperature sensor and active compensation (DualMEMS, TurboCompensation) keeps the frequency steady through airflow, thermal gradients, shock and vibration. On-chip regulators filter supply noise, so the part runs without its own external LDO.

On OE parts pin 1 has a pull-up of about 100 kΩ. High (at least 70% of Vdd), the clock runs; low (at most 30% of Vdd), the outputs go high impedance within 3.8 µs and the supply current falls to at most 63 mA. Where nothing drives pin 1, an external pull-up of 10 kΩ or less is recommended.
The clock is valid at most 3.0 ms after Vdd reaches its rated minimum.
VDD must be bypassed to GND with 0.1 µF or more. Lowest phase jitter needs an extra 10 µF across the same two pins.

The 5.0 x 3.2 mm and 7.0 x 5.0 mm packages have a center pad with no electrical function. Soldering it to GND gives the best heat dissipation but is not required. The 7.0 x 5.0 mm land pattern puts 8 thermal vias of 0.30 mm in the center pad.

All limits in the electrical tables hold with the standard termination for the output type. LVPECL drivers source up to 33 mA average and HCSL up to 35 mA average from each output pin; supply current figures exclude the termination current.

The maximum operating junction temperature rises with the temperature grade: 95 °C for the 70 °C grade, 110 °C for 85 °C, 120 °C for 95 °C and 130 °C for 105 °C. Above it the specifications do not hold.
In the top marking, Y is a code for the assembly site and XXXX the manufacturing lot.
